name: Giuseppe Farina
features: olive skin, dark hair receding at the temples, dark intense eyes, high forehead, sharp aquiline features, lean build, arrogant detached expression
bio: Doctor of law, nephew of the coachbuilder Pinin Farina and a pupil of Nuvolari. 'Nino' Farina drove with his arms straight and his head tilted back, a style copied for decades afterwards, and with a ruthlessness that frightened his rivals. Italian champion in 1937, 1938 and 1939, he went on to win the first Formula One World Championship in 1950.
